documents_expected.why: request for proposals: components, checklist, approvals, reporting (on the site's CDN)

eligibility.rule: Addresses one of MBF's four strategic initiatives
eligibility.quote: Projects must address one of the strategic initiatives of MBF: habitat conservation, scientific research and monitoring, outreach and education, or sustainable development.

eligibility.rule: Work in the Reserve has the Reserve authorities' approval
eligibility.quote: All projects to be carried out within the Monarch Butterfly Biosphere Reserve and surrounding areas must have the approval of the Reserve's authorities.

eligibility.rule: Work with local or indigenous communities has their approval
eligibility.quote: If the projects involve research, interaction/participation of local communities (ejidos and indigenous communities) or are in the communal properties, then they must also have approval from the parties involved.

eligibility.rule: Shows how the work contributes to forest or monarch conservation
eligibility.quote: This section MUST address how this work contributes to forest or monarch conservation.

documents.quote: A cover page with the title of the proposed project;
An abstract of 150 words or fewer.
A description of the affiliations and role of each participant in the project in addition to the primary applicant.
A summary of previous work by the organization,

documents.item: Description of proposed work with timeline
documents.quote: A summary of proposed work, with a project description and timeline.
A detailed budget with justification of proposed expenses (1 page),

documents.item: Written approval from affected groups (Reserve, communities, faculty advisor)
documents.quote: Approval by groups affected by this proposal.
alt_quotes: Written approval by affected groups (the Reserve, local communities, faculty advisor)

effort.step: Email the proposal as PDF or Word at any time
effort.quote: Applications may be submitted electronically as a PDF or a Microsoft Word document to grants@monarchconservation.org.

after_award.quote: In addition to a final report at the completion of the project, interim reports should be submitted by email to grants@monarchconservation.org whenever there are changes in the activities or planned expenses of the project.

notes: Up to $3,500 a year, renewable; rolling. Interim reports are only asked when activities or expenses change, so the schedule is 'final'. Preference for Mexican nationals and those with local experience is a preference, not a rule. The RFP PDF sits on the site's DigitalOcean CDN (linked from the call page).
